arabic text: NANA NABI DADA ALI DADI TERI KHAIRUN NISAA
english translation text: YOUR MATERNAL GRANDFATHER IS PROPHET MUHAMMAD (PBUH), YOUR PATERNAL GRANDFATHER IS IMAM ALI (A.S.), YOUR GRANDMOTHER IS HAZRAT FATIMA (S.A)

arabic text: TU HAI MASIHA-E-JAHAAN SHAAHE KHURASAAN HAI LAQAB YU HAR FARISHTA ROZ PAR\nAATAA HAI TERE BA ADAB HAAN RAD NAHI HOTI TERE ROZE PE\nKOI BHI DUA, NANA NABI DADA ALI DADI TERI KHAIRUN NISAA
english translation text: YOU ARE THE MESSIAH OF THE WORLD AND THE KING OF THE KHORASAN IS YOUR TITLE,\nEVERY ANGEL COMES TO YOUR SHRINE WITH UTMOST RESPECT,\nNO DU’A IS REJECTED AT YOUR DOOR STEP,

arabic text: BINAAI BHI DETA HAI TU GOYAAI BHI DETA HAI TU\nMAANGE AGAR TUJSE KOI DAANAAI BHI DETA HAI TU TU\nBHI TO BABE ILM HAI TU BHI TO HAI MUSHKIL KUSHAA,
english translation text: YOU GIVE EYESIGHT AND THE ABILITY TO SPEAK,\nYOU EVEN BESTOW WISDOM ON PEOPLE WHO ASK FOR IT,\nYOU ARE ALSO THE DOOR OF KNOWLEDGE AND THE SOLVER OF PROBLEMS

arabic text: HAI ZAAMINE AAHU BHI TU GUL BHI HAI TU KHUSHBU\nBHI TU HAI PONCHTA HAR AANKH SE GIRTE HUWE AANSU\nBHI TU TERI ATAAYE DEKH KAR DUSHMAN KO BHI KEHNAA PARAA,
english translation text: YOU ARE ZAMIN E AAHU (THE ONE WHO TOOK GUARANTEE FOR THE DEER),\nYOU WIPE THE TEARS FROM THE EYES OF THE AZADAR,\nAFTER SEEING YOUR GENEROSITY EVEN YOUR ENEMY HAD TO SAY,

arabic text: TERI KARAAMAATE NAZAR SHAB HO KE HO WAQTE SAHAR\nKEHTA HAI HAR ZAAIR TERA ROZE KI JAALI CHUM KAR\nMASHHAD MUQADDAS HO GAYA TUNE JO AAKAR DI AZAAN,
english translation text: WHEN YOU LOOK WITH KINDNESS THEN EVEN THE NIGHT CAN TURN INTO DAWN,\nTHIS IS WHAT EVERY PILGRIM SAYS WHILE KISSING YOUR SHRINE,\nMASHHAD BECAME HOLY AS A RESULT OF YOUR PRESENCE

arabic text: TERE HI DASTAR-KHAAN PAR HOTA HAI JANNAT KA GHUMAAN\nJINNO MALLAK LETE HAI SAB TERE HI DAR SE\nROTIYAA MAULA TERA MAKRUUZ HAI HAR IK GADAAO BAADSHAA,
english translation text: ONE IMAGINES AS IF ONE IS IN HEAVEN WHEN SITTING AT YOUR DASTAR KHWAN (FOOD SERVED IN THE SHRINE),\nTHE ANGELS AND JINNS RECEIVED THEIR SUSTENANCE AT YOUR STEP,\nEVERY KING AND BEGGAR OWES A DEBT TO YOU

arabic text: ROZE SE TERE DUUR HAI HAM TO BOHOT MAJBOOR HAI\nAANKHON SE AANSU HAI RAWAAN DIL BHI GHAMON SE CHUR\nHAI TUJSE KAHENGE HALE DIL IZNE ZIYARAT KAR ATAA,
english translation text: WE ARE FAR FROM YOUR SHRINE AND VERY HELPLESS,\nTEARS ARE FLOWING FROM OUR EYES AND OUR HEARTS ARE BROKEN,\nWE WILL SHARE WHAT IS IN OUR HEARTS WITH YOU

arabic text: *ROZO SHAB SHAAMO SAHAR, YE WAZIFA HAI MERA\nGARDISHE AYYAM ME GHIR KAR MEI BILKUL CHOOR THA
english translation text: MORN AND EVE, DAY AND NIGHT, THIS IS MY RECITATION\nTRAPPED IN DAILY MISERIES, I LAY TOTALLY SHATTERED

arabic text: ZINDAGI SE DOOR APNE AAP SE BHI DOOR THA\nUS GHARI MUJHKO TERE DAR KA SAHARA MILGAYA
english translation text: ESTRANGED FROM LIFE, ESTRANGED FROM MY OWN SOUL\nAT THAT TIME, I GOT THE SUPPORT OF YOUR (GENEROUS) DOOR

arabic text: KON HAI DILKI MURAADE JO YAHA PAATA NAHI\nAAP KE DAR SE KOI BHI KHAALI HAATH JAATA NAHI
english translation text: WHO IS IT WHOSE DEEPEST WISHES ARE NOT ANSWERED HERE?\nNO ONE IS EVER TURNED AWAY EMPTY-HANDED FROM YOUR DOOR

arabic text: HUMKO DAR SE AAPKE AUQAAT SE ZYAADA MILA
english translation text: WE RECEIVED MORE THAN WE DESERVED FROM YOUR DOOR

arabic text: KHALQ MEI MASH’HOOR HAI MUSHKIL KUSHAAI AAPKI\nKAR RAHE HAI JAANO DIL MIDHAT SARAAYI AAPKI
english translation text: YOUR HELP IN DISTRESS IS KNOWN ACROSS THE WORLD\nOUR HEARTS AND SOULS ARE CHANTING YOUR LOFTY PRAISES

arabic text: AI MERE MUSHKIL KUSHA\nDOOR HO MUSHKIL HAMAARI
english translation text: MAY ALL OUR PROBLEMS BE SOLVED\nO SOLVER OF MY PROBLEMS

arabic text: JO TABIBO KI NAZAR MEI THA MAREEZE LA ILAAJ\nDE RAHI THI MAUT KO BHI ZINDAGI JIS KI KHIRAAJ
english translation text: THE ONE WHO, IN THE EYES OF PHYSICIANS, WAS INCURABLY DISEASED\nTHE ONE WHOSE LIFE WAS BEING CONVEYED TO CERTAIN DEATH

arabic text: WO MAREEZE LA DAWA\nDAR PAR TERA ACHA HUWA
english translation text: THAT INCURABLE PATIENT\nWAS CURED AT YOUR DOOR

arabic text: MIL NAHI SAKTI MERE MAULA TERI KOI MISAAL\nJAANE AHMED ROOHE HAIDER FATEMA ZEHRA KE LAAAL
english translation text: O MY MASTER! THE LIKE OF YOU CAN NEVER BE FOUND\nTHE HEART OF AHMED, THE SOUL OF HAIDER, THE BELOVED OF FATEMA ZEHRA

arabic text: AI SHEHEN SHAAHE KHURASAAN\nIBNE SHAAHE KARBALA
english translation text: O THE KING OF KHURASAN!\nSON OF THE KING OF KARBALA
